substitutions.title: Native bridge bootstrap
substitutions.summary: Rust workspace + @earendil-works/pi-native N-API loader exposing rustVersion(). Nothing in Pi depends on it yet.

substitutions.title: packages/protocol CBOR + framing
substitutions.summary: Rust CBOR subset + framing behind setNativeCodec(protocolCodec). The TypeScript codec stays the default; the protocol test suite runs against both, plus a differential fuzz suite.

benchmark.note: Rust/TS time ratio, linux-x64, Node 22.20; lower is faster

substitutions.title: coding-agent find
substitutions.summary: In-process Rust port of the fd search behind the find tool (ignore + globset, same settings, output and error text as fd) behind setNativeFind(findFiles). fd stays the default. Only difference: results are always sorted; fd sorts only searches that finish within 100 ms.

benchmark.note: native/fd time ratio for one find tool call (fd process spawn vs in-process search), linux-x64, Node 22.20, fd 10.5.0; lower is faster
